changeStatus: UNCHANGED in window (interaction-coupled orchestrator; primary consumer of the new NFTStakerDepletionV2 -- V1->V2 migrations run through this contract).

cloneRelationship.twin: _depositForAndForward is deliberately line-for-line identical to InPlaceNFTStakerMigrator's (plan D-6; a divergence there is the pns20h1 fork-drift class)

role: Two-staker migration orchestrator (old -> new). Pulls users' ERC1155 via oldStaker.batchMigrate (which settles pending phUSD to users), redeposits into newStaker via depositFor. Intra-call ERC1155 custody only.

verifiedProperties.noUnboundedLoops: loops bounded by onlyOwner-supplied users[] (batched off-chain)
verifiedProperties.constructorChecks: non-zero old/new/stakedToken/rewardToken; old != new; rewardToken cross-checked vs BOTH stakers' rewardToken() getters (IStakerViews)
verifiedProperties.captureAndForward: verified mechanism: per-iteration snapshot of newStaker.pendingReward(user) + own rewardToken balance around depositFor; captured delta bounded by owed (tripwire, fires only on foreign inflow mid-call e.g. mispointed hook recipient); forward via raw transfer in try/catch, failure escrows to unforwarded[user]; self-disabling (captured==0) against conforming V2/MigrateReady targets
verifiedProperties.escrowProtection: totalUnforwarded floors rescueERC20(rewardToken) -- no owner path to escrowed user value; claimForwarded strict CEI
verifiedProperties.approvalHygiene: setApprovalForAll(newStaker, true) only when total>0, revoked at end of migrate
verifiedProperties.erc1155Rescue: UNCONDITIONAL (documented: custody is intra-call only, no totalParked analogue to protect)

localFindings.description: Documented off-chain caveat: against a V1 target the staker emits Claimed(user, pending) while payment traverses staker->migrator->user; indexers must join RewardForwarded/RewardForwardFailed. No on-chain compensation. Not a finding; recorded for report continuity.

externalCalls: per user: newStaker.pendingReward, rewardToken.balanceOf, newStaker.depositFor, rewardToken.transfer(user) in try/catch

methods: rewardToken.transfer -- recipient could be a contract; failure escrowed, cannot DoS batch

trustAssumptions: Both stakers share stakedToken + stakedId (constructor cannot verify stakedId equality -- wiring assumption)
Migrator set as `migrator` on both stakers before use
New staker deployed + wired (hook, dispatcherIndex) before migrate
